messages.subject: Energy Transition Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Strategic Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Karpel,

Karpel Associates' dedicated renewable-energy executive-search practice is relevant to my leadership background at the intersection of responsible mining, energy transition, ESG and institutional affairs. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, leading government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am exploring Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates where energy-transition growth requires regulatory coordination, stakeholder trust and disciplined execution. I am internationally mobile and open to senior international appointments.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
